profile.summary: Heads UP Ventures Limited operates fashion apparels and accessories business in India and internationally. It retails and distributes shirts, t-shirt, jackets, hoodies, sweatshirts, caps, hats, socks, underwear, belts, bags, and flip flops. It offers its products under the HUP and Device of Turtle brand names and, as well as through e-commerce platform. The company was formerly known as The Mandha
